pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Averbakh, 7.c3 Bg4
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the knight via d2 with the d-pawn still there and proposed a4-b4; plan 2 developed the light-squared bishop to b7 when it is already on g4. Rewrote plans 1-2. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Averbakh, 7.c3 Bg4 8.d3
pages.notes: Plan 2's ...h5 and ...Ne7 made no sense with the bishop on e7; plan 4 developed the g4-bishop to b7. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Averbakh, 7.c3 Bg4 8.h3
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the knight via d2 before d4; plan 3 said ...Bxf3 damages White's pawns when the queen recaptures; plan 2 was vague. Rewrote all four plans. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Averbakh, 7.c3 O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nf1-g3 with no knight on f1; plan 2 gave the Breyer as ...Nb8-d7 with the knight on c6. Rewrote plans 1-2. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Averbakh, 7.c3 O-O 8.d4 Bd7
pages.notes: Plan 2 rerouted the d7-bishop to c8 for the long diagonal; plan 1 played Nf1-g3 with no knight on f1. Rewrote overview and plans 1-2.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Averbakh, 7.c3 O-O 8.h3
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the knight via d2 before d4; plan 4 gave ...Na5-c7, which a knight cannot play. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Averbakh, 7.c3 O-O 8.h3 Bd7
pages.notes: Overview had the bishop rerouted to c8; plan 2 played ...Bb7 with the bishop on d7; plan 1 played Nf1-g3 with no knight on f1. Rewrote overview and plans 1-2 (first overview rejected for a false causal claim; corrected and accepted). British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed
pages.notes: Plan 2 routed the knight through the d2-pawn. Rewrote plan 2. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed
pages.notes: Overview was generic and missed the Marshall choice that 7...O-O offers; plan 2 gave ...Na5-c5; plan 3 called the queen's knight the king's knight and played it from f1. Rewrote overview and plans 2-3. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Anti-Marshall
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the knight via d2-c4 or f1-e3-g2. Rewrote plan 1. British spelling.
